html:
Boss Difficulty System

Version

15.30.a30dad
July 13, 2026
Summer Update 2026

Status

Active
The Boss Difficulty System, also referred by CIP on forums as Scalable Difficulty Mode, was introduced with Summer Update 2026, as a way to create dynamic and scalable boss fights. The bosses from the Make Believe Quest, released in the same update, were the first to enable this system.

For each boss with this system enabled, each party can choose how challenging a fight should be, from a safe learning mode (but where death is still a possibility) to the highest difficulties (with new mechanics, stronger bosses, and greater rewards). Higher difficulties must first be unlocked by defeating bosses in lower difficulties. Every character unlocks progress individually, so groups must work their way upwards together. Higher difficulties increase loot chances and are required for exclusive rewards, such as specific titles or specific item drops. The difficulty selection UI appears once the lever is pulled, the battle will actually be started through the new UI window.

  • Stage 2: Moonsilver Sentinels create Storm boosting fields on death. Stepping on them will inflict Lesser Hex that lasts for around 12 seconds.
  • Stage 3: Area damage spells affect the boss room:
    • Every 10 seconds, most glass like tiles are affected by a very powerful (20,000+) Holy Damage spell
       Room's Holy Spell
    • Every 15 seconds, most black tiles are affected by a very powerful (25,000+) Death Damage spell
       Room's Death Spell
    • This means that every 30 seconds both spells will trigger at the same time, covering a huge area of the room
  • Stage 3: Draining fields appear in the boss room.
      • Sanctified Draining Rifts appear randomly around the room. When stepping on them, players take 40% of their maximum HP as Agony Damage (bypassing Barrier, Magic Shield, and Gift of Life).

History

  • On August 18, 2026, a fix was applied where HP percentage-based Agony Damage was incorrectly affected by boss difficulty scaling. The damage from the affected mechanics no longer scales with the difficulty of these boss fights. However, these mechanics now bypass Barrier, Magic Shield, and Gift of Life, directly reducing the player's hit points.
